column1: # Character names: the US name (as the English text has it) <TAB> the name shown instead when
# [text] names = jp (settings.ini; the default). Whole words only; a colour code right before a
# name ("*c4Cody*c7") counts as a word break. The player's own name is never changed.
# Built into the program (cmake/EmbedFiles.cmake); src/game/overrides/text.cpp applies it.
